live.note: 21 day incubation, 30 day season, seeded with 24 hosts, 3 recoveries and 2 vaccinations. The token icon and then the standards upgrade (near-contract-standards traits, embedded ABI, NEP-330 metadata, NEP-145 withdraw and unregister) were code-only redeploys with state preserved. So was the 2026-11-12 update: vaccination price that rises with each vaccination, stricter new() checks, get_stats with the current vaccine price and the time-end reason, and the repository link in the source metadata.

demo.note: 3 minute incubation, 2 hour season, for recording the full cycle. Its only patient zero expired minutes after deployment by design, so it is dead now: run scripts/deploy-testnet.sh demo <new-name> <zero> right before recording, then scripts/seed-testnet.sh.

demo_video.note: Deployed 2026-11-12 10:30 UTC for the demo video (3 minute incubation, 2 hour season), so its season is over. Same wasm as the live instance at that time.

demo_wallet_test.note: Deployed 2026-11-12 15:28 UTC with the verified reproducible wasm for the wallet test: catch, recover, vaccinate and claim signed through near-connect. Its season ended by herd immunity at 8 immune of 25 infected.

demo_video_2.note: Deployed 2026-11-12 15:43 UTC with the verified reproducible wasm; recover, vaccinate to herd immunity and claim were recorded here for the demo video.

demo_late_recover.note: Deployed 2026-11-12 15:39 UTC for the late recover wallet test (50% burn after the clock ran out). Two hour season, so it is over.
